descriptions.zh:
释放预定容器的操作具有原子性，不存在部分成功或部分失败的情况。 当释放任务成功时，HTTP接口消息通知如下： > HTTP接口是接收会话启动、停止、串流等信息的一种方式。目前消息保存1天，重试策略为退避策略，最多重试176次。 事件类型为`RELEASE_CAPACITY_RESULT`。 >不区分模式，仅推送HTTP接口。> | 名称| 类型| 是否必选 | 说明 | | ------ | ------ |----|------ | |success|Boolean|是|任务是否成功。
取值：
true：任务成功。
false：任务失败。 | eventType|String|是|事件类型。| eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|是|事件详情。
当任务成功时，返回该参数。| EventDetail数据结构如下所示。 | 名称| 类型| 是否必选 | 说明 | | ------ | ------ |----|------ | | taskId | String | 是 |容器异步释放任务ID。 | | success |Boolean | 是 |释放是否成功。
取值：
true：释放成功。
false：释放失败。 | | expectReleaseSessionCapacity | Integer | 是 |期望释放的会话路数。 |
descriptions.en:
The operation to release a reserved container is atomic, meaning there is no scenario of partial success or partial failure. When the release job succeeds, the HTTP API sends a notification message as follows: > The HTTP API is a method for receiving notifications about session start, stop, streaming, and other events. Currently, messages are retained for 1 Day, and the retry policy is a backoff strategy with up to 176 retries. The event type is `RELEASE_CAPACITY_RESULT`. >Pattern is not distinguished; notifications are pushed only via the HTTP API.> | Name | Type | Required | Description | | ------ | ------ |----|------ | | success | Boolean | Yes | Indicates whether the job succeeded.
Valid values:
true: The job succeeded.
false: The job failed. | | eventType | String | Yes | The event type. | | eventDetail | Object[EventDetail] | Yes | The event details.
This parameter is returned only when the job succeeds. | The data structure of EventDetail is as follows. | Name | Type | Required | Description | | ------ | ------ |----|------ | | taskId | String | Yes | The ID of the asynchronous container release job. | | success | Boolean | Yes | Indicates whether the release succeeded.
Valid values:
true: The release succeeded.
false: The release failed. | | expectReleaseSessionCapacity | Integer | Yes | The expected number of ingest endpoints of sessions to release. |
